messages:
claire: Pushed a micro-update to the dashboard chart in staging. At narrow widths the axis units overlap the legend and the chart becomes visually noisy. Screenshot: https://staging.redwood.app/snap/6001

ben: Saw it. Quick wins: use SI suffixes for large numbers, switch to 3 major ticks on small tiles, and move units into an abbreviated unit chip next to the axis (e.g., 'ms' chip) so labels don't collide.

ricky: For the legend, what about a compact "chip list" pattern instead of inline text? Small square chips with color + 1-2 char label, and full names exposed in a keyboard-focusable flyout. Keeps the tile tidy.

sam: Accessibility: if we show condensed chips visually, ensure a screen-reader-only list exists in DOM order with full series names and roles. Also avoid announcing every tick; instead expose a short aria summary: e.g., `aria-label="Latency: median 120ms, p95 430ms"`.

lila: Outlier handling idea: cap the y-axis at p98 and surface an "outlier chip" above the chart that reads "5 outliers". Clicking the chip opens a modal with the raw timestamps and values. The chip should be focusable and have `aria-label` that includes the top outlier value.

ben: On smoothing: don't hide raw data. Show raw line by default with an unobtrusive smoothed line as an overlay toggle in the flyout. When smoothing is enabled, show a small badge on the chip: "S" with tooltip "smoothed trend".

claire: UX detail: when many chips exist, collapse into a single "+N" chip that expands the flyout. Keyboard users must be able to expand via Enter/Space. Flyout should trap focus and include a close button.

ricky: For overlapping outliers, render a stacked marker with a small number badge instead of jittering the x position; tooltip lists individual values. Jittering felt noisy in prior tests.

sam: VoiceOver nit: avoid spamming announcements during live updates. Use `aria-live="polite"` and debounce announcements to once every 5s max. Also expose an offscreen CSV export link for power users.

lila: Copy suggestions: chip tooltip for axis unit: "milliseconds (ms)"; outlier chip tooltip: "5 outliers above 2.1s, open details". Keep visible text short.

qa-bot: visual-diff-bot: PR #6001 - visual diffs: 1 minor spacing change flagged, no accessibility regressions detected by automated checks.

claire: Next steps: ben to prototype chip list + unit chip, ricky to mock outlier chip + modal, sam to run manual NVDA/VoiceOver on the flyout states, lila to draft microcopy. We'll ship behind flag and run a small pilot.
